text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Reconstruction of Macedonian government expected after May 15, paper learns from reliable sources. Posts of health, justice and construction and ecology ministers already vacant.

- After adoption of changes of the customs law duty free shops at Macedonian border posts are closed while the shops on the other side of the border with Greece, Yugoslavia and Bulgaria immediately hiked the price of their goods.
- Russian President Boris Yeltsin sent a personal messge to Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov expressing Russia's desire to strenghthen cooperation.

- Depositors of the bankrupt TAT financial institution from Bitola demand owner Sonja Nikolovska disclose names of influential personalities who were able to withdraw almost 30 million German marks from the bank in the period from January to March this year.
- U.N. Under-Secretary for peace-keeping operations Bernard Millet arriving in Macedonia on Tuesday where he will talk with high Macedonian officials and visit the UNPREDEP mission.

- Industrial production rose 4.3 percent in the first three months this year in relation to the same period last year. There are 246,584 registered unemployed. There are 332,334 employed, which is 4.9 percent less than last year. In February 24.1 percent of the employed did not receive their salaries. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
